Index.title: Start from zero. Build real tech products.

Hero.headline: START FROM ZERO. BUILD REAL TECH PRODUCTS.
Hero.description: AIOT Club at the Institute of Digital Technology - Thu Dau Mot University is an environment for students passionate about AI, IoT, Embedded Systems, Robotics, and UAVs to learn, research, and develop real-world projects.

About.title: What is AIOT Club?
About.description: AIOT Club is a student technology club under the Institute of Digital Technology, Thu Dau Mot University. It provides an environment for students to learn from basics, practice through real projects, and join tech competitions.
About.quote: You don't need to be an expert to join. You come here to become one.
